title: CISA Adds Actively Exploited Windows WinSock Vulnerability to KEV Catalog
content_md: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a critical Microsoft Windows vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, warning that the flaw is actively being exploited in real-world attacks.
